title: A Kiwi Lays an Egg Up to 20% of Her Own Body Weight

scenes.text: This bird lays an egg a fifth of her body weight.
A kiwi egg can be up to twenty percent of the mother's weight.
That's like a woman giving birth to a baby over twenty pounds.
Kiwis are chicken-sized, but they lay one of the biggest eggs of any bird, compared to body size.
The egg takes about eighty days to hatch.
One egg. A fifth of her weight.

description:

first_comment: New Zealand's conservation department puts the average at 15 percent. Still huge. Guess the egg-to-body record holder?
